description: This Java class implements an HTTP endpoint for tenant management within the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides REST API routes for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tenant information, by routing HTTP requests to the appropriate internal event bus messages. It handles CORS, request payload extraction, path parameter handling, and interacts with other components for tenant management operations.

classes.name: TenantManagementHttpEndpoint
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractHttpEndpoint, implementing REST API routes for tenant management (create, read, update, delete). Uses Vert.x for HTTP handling, processes JSON payloads, and interacts with the event bus for tenant operations.

methods.name: updatePayloadWithTenantId
methods.description: Ensures the tenant ID in the payload matches the request context, injecting it if necessary, or fails with a bad request error if empty.

methods.name: getTenantIdFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID from the request context, either from URL parameters or payload.

methods.name: createTenant
methods.description: Handles the creation of a tenant by sending an event bus message and setting Location header on success.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Handles fetching tenant info via event bus request.

methods.name: updateTenant
methods.description: Updates tenant information via event bus request, sets the ETag header on response.

methods.name: deleteTenant
methods.description: Deletes a tenant by sending delete message through the event bus.

methods.name: doTenantHttpRequest
methods.description: Performs the internal event bus message for tenant operations, handling success and failure responses.

methods.name: getTenantParamFromPayload
methods.description: Extracts the tenant ID parameter from the JSON payload.
